statement:
The claim record for CL-7712 shows an **approved amount of USD 480,000**, but the policy (PL-40) pays at most **USD 50,000**.

I will now pay **USD 50,000** in accordance with the policy limit.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the approved USD 480,000 exceeds the policy's USD 50,000 maximum and gives the correct payable amount ("I will now pay USD 50,000 in accordance with the policy limit").
